resources.string: Open PiuLink Host on your Windows PC and keep it awake. Connect the TV and PC to the same home network using Ethernet or Wi-Fi.
Find a PC on this network
For remote access, connect the TV and computer to the same Tailscale network. Approve the VPN request on the TV, then return here.
Tailscale is not installed on this TV.
Choose your computer or enter its network address. If a PIN appears on the TV, enter it in PiuLink Host on the computer. The TV will remember this pairing.
